podcast.body: This song reached number two on the Billboard Hot 100 and number eight on the country chart, marking one of their last significant country crossovers. Robert Hilburn compared it to The Flying Burrito Brothers' "Sin City" due to its shared themes of materialism and city life. "lion eyes went to number two on the billboard hot 100 and number eight on the country chart."
